unresolved: Porcelain origin has three different upper bounds across the six volumes (Shang, Shang-Zhou transition, Warring States) with no dating method or laboratory code

The 'proto-porcelain' / 'mature porcelain' boundary rests on one specimen analysis (Shangyu Xiaoxiantan, no residual quartz under glaze) and one other criterion (weak water absorption at Zhangjiapo); the two are not interchangeable
White porcelain origin: the Northern Qi claim is supported by dated tombs, but Tian Zibing himself says the exact date awaits more excavation
Mise porcelain: 13 vs 16 pieces from the Famen Temple crypt; Tang vs Five Dynasties-Wuyue attribution; the term 'mise' itself is never explained
Piao porcelain is tied to Ou kiln by one volume only; Li Lixin's two-celadon-system thesis does not reconcile with the four-kiln-system division
Yuezhou kiln is single-source and low confidence; its claim to have used saggars first conflicts with the Northern and Southern Dynasties saggar find

Huayou (splashed glaze) kiln attribution is open (Jiaxian, Lushan, Neixiang, Yu xian); the Lushan kiln drum and the huayou waist drum may be two records of one object, so the former was left unmounted as a duplicate candidate
Yue kiln lotus bowl with leaf stand exists only as a plate caption; the six decorative methods of Six Dynasties celadon come from Tian Zibing alone
Kiln and firing evidence lacks temperature curves, stacking counts, yields and cost comparisons; mantou kiln and gourd kiln each rest on a single sentence
Secondary firing (biscuit firing plus glaze firing) is documented only for Tang sancai, a low-fired earthenware; not mounted in B.6
B.6.3-B.6.5 were not created although material is abundant (roughly 140 porcelain-related unmounted B-dimension KUs); candidates recorded in this manifest and in dimension-candidates.md
Pottery/porcelain boundary is inconsistent across the volumes; double mounting between B.5 and B.6 may be needed for proto-porcelain
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Theme（B.6 瓷器工艺与窑业传统）与 2 个 Topic（B.6.1–B.6.2），挂载 43 个 KU。结构设计的三项判断：其一，沿用 h21 已确立的“材料组为主题边界、问题为研究问题”路线，陶与瓷按材料分工，B.6 只收瓷器与原始瓷的瓷器面，陶器、低温釉陶、琉璃与紫砂仍归 B.5；其二，B.6 内部按“材料判据—窑业条件—命名系统”三层组织，B.6.1 取判据与命名（原始瓷、青瓷、白瓷、黑瓷、缥瓷、秘色瓷、花釉 + 汉至五代窑址 + 出土材料 + 代表器物），B.6.2 取窑业条件（窑炉、窑具、装烧、胎釉工艺），不按朝代罗列；其三，B.6.3–B.6.5 材料充足但本批不建立，理由是单批挂载量已到 43 个，继续扩大将失去逐条语义复读，而非 h21 那种“无材料不建空壳”的理由。唐三彩二次烧成法经复核后主动不挂：其唯一案例是低温釉陶，挂入瓷器 Theme 会造成材料层级混淆。原始瓷在来源中同时被称“釉陶”与“瓷器”，本批只开交叉引用、不做双挂载。本批把 dim-candidates 中 v1.12 记录的“按材料组还是按生产技术问题”的待决问题改写为已按材料组执行，并保留跨材料技术问题（铸造、榫卯、织造、营造）再评估的入口。执行过程中一次关系生成失败：43 个 KU 的 `topic_memberships[].topic` 初写为裸文件名，`build_relation_index.py` 的 `_materialized_structure_target` 只接受 `topics/*.md` 形式，导致 Topic `member_of` 关系为 0；改为全路径后重建，`member_of` 由 488 增至 574（43 Theme + 43 Topic）。v1.12 归档哈希 fd727ba6e18318873f8ba25802507c89709fd70540a6be16c4f4b867e8cf42dc 与 h21 apply-plan 记录逐字节一致。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
